title: Brugada Announces Priority Public Works for Colonia Selene in Tláhuac
detail: Jefa de Gobierno Clara Brugada announced a package of priority works for Colonia Selene and Ampliación Selene in the Tláhuac borough: seven public schools will be renovated under the '1, 2, 3 por mi Escuela' program at MXN 2 million each (MXN 14 million total), covering bathroom renewal, structural safety work, waterproofing and roofing; each school also receives an 'Aula Mixtli' digital classroom and free music instruction through the 'Do-Re-Mi-Fa-Sol' program. Additional works include lighting 17 km of Eje 10 as a 'Camino de Mujeres Libres y Seguras' women's safety corridor, repaving Calle Océano de las Tempestades, developing Parque Alegría, continued efforts to reduce dependence on water-delivery trucks, ongoing Cablebús construction, and a new Utopía community center offering free sports, culture and childcare.

media.caption: Clara Brugada announces priority public works for Colonia Selene, Tláhuac
